description: This file defines the RedisClusteringProviderBuilder class which configures Redis clustering providers for Orleans silos and clients. It uses dependency injection and configuration options to set up Redis connections via the StackExchange.Redis library.

classes.name: RedisClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Redis clustering providers for Orleans silos and clients, setting up connection options based on configuration.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Configures a silo builder to use Redis clustering, setting up connection options based on configuration parameters (service key or connection string).

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures a client builder to use Redis clustering, similarly setting up connection options based on provided configuration.
